content: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Officer Daniel Reeves, badge number 74263. Who am I speaking with today?
Um, hi, my name is Ashley Turner. I got a voicemail saying there was a problem with my taxes?

Yes, Ms. Turner. This call concerns critical discrepancies in your recent federal tax filings, specifically, failures to submit 1099 compliance forms for your self-employment income. How long have you been operating as a freelancer?
I just started freelancing last year, honestly. I didn't know I needed special forms. Is something wrong?

According to IRS records, you failed to report substantial income and did not remit required payroll taxes. This is in violation of federal statutes. Can you confirm your date of birth and the address associated with your tax account so I can verify your identity and proceed?
Uh, my birthday is April 7, 1998, and my address is 410 Maple Street, Apartment 3B, Willow City, 10432. Please, am I in trouble?

Thank you. I have your file now. Ms. Turner, the matter is very serious. There's an outstanding tax balance of $3,870 due to unreported earnings and failure to file. Do you understand the consequences for non-compliance?
I... I don't really understand. I thought I did everything right. What happens now?

If this is not resolved today, you could be subject to a federal audit, your bank accounts can be frozen, and your business license may be revoked. In extreme cases, the IRS can initiate legal action for tax evasion. Are you prepared to face these penalties?
No, please! I can't have my bank account frozen. I barely make enough as it is. Is there anything I can do?

There is a protocol to allow voluntary compliance before enforcement. We can accept an immediate settlement payment to halt escalation. Do you have access to your checking account or any payment cards at this moment?
I... I have a debit card and some money in my account, but not a lot. I'm paying off student loans.
How much can you pay right now to avoid fees increasing and enforcement actions proceeding? It is critical you act before your case is transferred to the criminal investigations unit.
I think maybe I could manage $1,000, but that's about it. I don't have more.
We can start with that. For security, the IRS is only accepting instant settlement via electronic payment or certified vouchers today. Do you have access to a nearby Walgreens, CVS, or Walmart?
Um, there's a Walgreens a few blocks away. Why do I have to go there?
To avoid further penalties, you must immediately purchase IRS-authorized payment vouchers, these are processed as prepaid cards. I will stay on the line while you travel. Do not disconnect this call.
Wait, I have to leave right now? Can't I just pay online or something?

No, online portals are suspended for cases under enforcement review. If you hang up or delay, your file will be flagged for asset seizure and you could face a formal audit. Do you understand what's at stake?
Yes, okay, okay. I'll go. What am I supposed to buy at Walgreens?
You must purchase $1,000 in prepaid Visa gift cards. This is the only method to process voluntary compliance today. Once purchased, you will read me the numbers on the back for immediate settlement.
That seems weird. Is this really how the IRS does things?
This is a temporary measure for cases in violation status. I am a federal officer, failure to comply will result in enforcement. Now, confirm when you are at the store.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Please don't do anything to my account. I'm so stressed.

Remain calm. I will guide you through the process. When you have the gift cards, return to a quiet area and read me the codes. Do not speak to anyone about this, as it could legally compromise your case.
Alright. I'll call you as soon as I get them. You promise this will stop the penalties?
Yes. As soon as you provide the codes, the IRS will issue a compliance certificate and halt all enforcement. Now, confirm your cell phone number for verification.
Thank you, Ms. Turner. Remember, do not disconnect or discuss this with anyone until we complete your settlement. Let me know when you arrive.
